backend/main.mo: Main Motoko canister implementing user profiles, availability, daily logs, chat, and permission‑checked query methods for calendar and stats features.
feature_evidence.json: Defines feature-to-file mapping evidence for recent UI, admin, notification, and leaderboard updates with metadata and linked components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file, including pages, hooks, components, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme CSS variables and applying global background, foreground, and border styles.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file that loads the React application via main.tsx and provides the root mount element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the router, authentication gate, profile-setup flow, layout wrapper, and all major route configurations.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Renders an admin-only access denied message with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login UI using Internet Identity with branded background, logo, and sign-in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple component that renders the app’s logo using branding configuration.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Renders a group chat panel with message fetching, scrolling, and send functionality including older-message toggling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Displays navigation buttons based on router state and admin privilege.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Shows the app header with branding, theme toggle, and user menu including logout.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Allows users to view and edit their profile name and picture with upload handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Fetches leaderboard data and shows the caller’s current rank.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Displays the user's match history with loading, empty, and error states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: A modal prompting new users to enter and save their display name.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children with a fixed background image layer.
Renders a user avatar and name with initials fallback and size options.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Hooks for fetching and saving the caller’s user profile using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch the caller's user role and admin status from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInAppNotifications: Implements polling-based availability and leaderboard notifications, triggering toasts when new items or rank changes occur.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity React context for login, logout, and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability, leaderboard data, and caller-specific info.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and DOM class updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Fetches display names and optional avatars for principals, providing directory maps for UI lookup.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light/dark themes and global styling.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports centralized branding constants including app name and logo URLs.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for date/dayId conversions, calendar grids, and date/time formatting.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Provides a form to add or edit a user's daily availability, including time selection and notes, and submits it via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for managing users, their availabilities, and login timestamps, with deletion actions and directory lookups.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Displays a monthly calendar with availability indicators and navigation, allowing users to view or add availability for specific days.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Renders the group chat page containing a full-height chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows all availabilities for a specific day, allows the caller to add, edit, or delete their availability, and displays user info.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Displays the leaderboard and lets users record or remove daily wins and losses tied to their available days.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Shows the user's profile, leaderboard ranking, and recent match history using dedicated profile components.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides helpers to convert files to Uint8Array for uploads and to derive initials from a name for avatars.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides helpers for generating time dropdown options, formatting time strings, and parsing them into components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based routing parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, feature requests, issues, and metadata for UI updates, admin fixes, logs, and notifications.
